sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

This pump 
is located into the pits at the level of 63.5 and it's 
function is to dewater the drainage water in the pit and dewater the unit.

This document is initiated and tested by eng. Ahmed Abdel Qader Mahmoud, 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Baset Ahmed Rekaby: Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should will trained & qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area are required

Safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety helmet, safety shoes ... 
 etc.
The pit is dewatered.
